call_points.text: Raw cotton import duty and AIDC exempted from June 1 to October 31, 2026, reducing input costs across value chain.
Expanding cotton yarn manufacturing footprint through a planned facility in Madhya Pradesh alongside existing Silvassa facility.
Technical yarn capacity at Silvassa doubling from 9,000 MTPA to 18,000 MTPA by Q1FY27 end.
Exit March 2026 net debt was close to ₹1,325 Cr.
Annual term loan repayments projected at ₹100-125 Cr.
Peak top-line revenue expected to reach ₹7,500-7,700 Cr by end of FY28.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,169.18 Cr, net profit ₹21.57 Cr.
Sanathan Textiles filed its Q4 FY2026 monitoring agency report showing full utilization of ₹400 Cr IPO proceeds.
Sanathan Textiles Limited shared the earnings call audio link for Q4FY26 and FY26 results, approved by the Board on May 15, 2026, via Jude Patrick Dsouza.
Sanathan Textiles guided FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹5,600–5,700 Cr and EBITDA north of ₹500 Cr on Q4FY26 call.
Sanathan Textiles highlighted government duty exemption on raw cotton imports effective June-October 2026 as a margin positive for its cotton yarn business.

Sanathan Textiles Limited scheduled an earnings call for Q2 and H1 FY27 ending September 30, 2026, on November 05, 2026, at 05:00 PM IST with Mr. Paresh Dattani, Mr. Sammir Dattani, Mr. Sanjay Shah, and Mr. Jude Dsouza.
